content.short: Kuru is a high-performance CLOB DEX on Monad providing a CEX-like trading experience fully on-chain.
content.description:
Kuru is a pioneering decentralized exchange built natively on the Monad blockchain, designed to offer a professional-grade trading experience with sub-second finality. Unlike traditional AMMs, Kuru utilizes a Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) architecture, providing the tight spreads and limit order functionality typically found on centralized exchanges. By leveraging Monad's parallel execution and high throughput, Kuru delivers near-instant trade execution and deep liquidity fully on-chain.

The platform also features "Kuru Flow," a smart liquidity aggregator that unifies liquidity across the Monad ecosystem to ensure the best possible rates for traders. Backed by top-tier venture firms like Paradigm, Kuru is building the foundational infrastructure for high-frequency decentralized trading. Through its commitment to transparency and performance, Kuru is empowering the next generation of DeFi participants with institutional-grade trading tools in a non-custodial framework.
content.meta: Kuru offers professional-grade on-chain order book trading and liquidity aggregation on the Monad blockchain.
